title: Fulfillment booking intent survives a concurrent manual shipment
question: Как восстановить бронь перевозчика, если manual ship обогнал network response?

options.text: Private durable booking_requested before port call; same reference recovery; attach matching tracking or return booking in conflict error
Serialize manual ship behind network call
options.cons: Transaction/lock held during carrier network; violates adopted boundary

context: Grok 4.7 G1: конфликт carrier result терялся при повторном book из-за раннего возврата shipped view.
decision: Commit private booking_requested intent before the carrier port call; retry same reference after manual shipment; attach matching method/label without duplicate shipment; return purchased BookedShipment in FulfillmentAlreadyShipped on conflict. Additive migration and optional exception property/scalar context; Shipping owns network idempotency.
rationale: Owner delegated architecture and requested all audit defects fixed. Recoverability without holding database locks across network and without a second carrier journal.
